question: RTX 3090 Arc A770 VRAM bandwidth specs

sources.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: The GeForce RTX 3090 was an enthusiast-class graphics card by NVIDIA, launched on September 24th, 2020. Built on the 8 nm process, and based on the GA102 graphics processor, in its GA102-300-A1 variant, the card supports DirectX 12 Ultimate.

sources.title: Intel Arc A770 Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: The Arc A770 was a performance-segment graphics card by Intel, launched on October 12th, 2022. Built on the 6 nm process, and based on the DG2-512 graphics processor, in its ACM-G10 variant, the card supports DirectX 12 Ultimate.
